name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: 这点对 $AVGO 挺关键的，AI 加速器越做越大，封装和 HBM 整合跟不上，交付一样会被卡住。原帖也提了客户在推供应链多元化，这块能不能跟上，值得继续看。
Anthropic 修订版招股书披露，博通是它算力租赁的最大头：五年 1612 亿美元 TPU 租赁，部分已上线、更多从 2027 年起交付。订单是硬支撑，但兑现节奏看 Anthropic 自己的融资和变现——Q3 它的算力成本增速已经跑赢了收入增速。$AVGO

Interesting angle from Broadcom's own blog: as AI spreads across sites, the switch itself becomes the bottleneck. Buffer depth of 1.5x the bandwidth-delay product keeps retransmissions near zero. HBM in a switch sounds odd until you do the math on 10km of fiber.

Glass makes sense for 120mm+ — warpage is the real limiter at that size. If Broadcom and Nvidia are already locking 2027 TGV capacity, the bottleneck shifts to yield and how fast suppliers can scale, not just the substrate itself.
AVGO 一天跌掉 10.4%，收在 $291.53，离 52 周低点 $289.96 只剩一块。这一刀砍的是审批预期不是需求：德州新州长要延长数据中心审批暂停，德州占 2028 年新增产能的 41%。博通 Q3 AI 收入 167 亿（+221%）、Q4 指引 217 亿没变，订单是推迟不是消失。RSI 31.4，情绪到了，修复得等政策松口。$AVGO
这个分歧挺关键的。Arcuri 讲弹性有道理，但超大规模客户已经用长约和预付款锁 HBM，说明自研路线下了重注。短期波动难免，关键还是看明年订单有没有真的松动。

R&D is the one line item you can't fake. Nvidia outspending AMD, Broadcom and Marvell combined says a lot about where the gap sits. At $11.8B, Broadcom is still spending like a company that intends to stay in the race. $AVGO

That supply-demand gap is the key point. If hyperscaler demand really is running ahead of supply, 15x forward earnings looks more like fear pricing than a growth call. Still, the $325.48 close stayed under the 20-day at $338.95, so I'm waiting for a hold first.

A 100 Tbps switch you can hold in one hand says a lot about where the bottleneck moved. The interesting line here is not the cadence, it is the discipline: ship a chip only when it is worth producing. For Broadcom, that restraint is part of the networking story. $AVGO
博通把 VMware 又往低端推了一步：vSphere Express 只面向 128 核以下的场景，vMotion、分布式交换机这些核心能力都给了，走按核订阅、分销渠道。说白了就是把原来够不着 VCF 的中小客户也圈进来。软件这条线要是能放量，对 AVGO 的意义不比 AI 芯片小，只是兑现要慢一些。$AVGO
